text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.734.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
Installed GBrain v0.60.734.0 from the exact release tag and registered it with Hermes.

Your original identity and existing configuration are preserved. Added a marked memory-policy section and brain-first hook; Hermes’s hook check passes.

Verified with real GBrain calls:
  CLI and MCP remember → recall passed.
  Recall persisted after reopening the process.
  Exact keyword search passed.
  Correction and withdrawal passed; test fixtures no longer appear in active recall/search.

A fresh Hermes conversation could not be verified: the existing inference provider returned connection errors. Restart Hermes to load the new tools in your interactive session.

Current settings:
  Search: conservative, keyword-only, no GBrain provider keys.
  Automatic fact saving/capture: off.
  Free in-session upkeep: on.
  Local redacted conversation archive: on. Disable with:
    gbrain transcripts archive off
  No daemon, cron, connectors, or paid enrichment installed.

Search-mode choice:
  conservative — 4K-token budget, 10 chunks, no reranker; active.
  balanced — 12K-token budget, 25 chunks, reranking when configured.
  tokenmax — no token budget, 50 chunks, reranking when configured.

Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.

These are illustrative model API costs, not your subscription price. Keyless retrieval is local, but recalled text reaches your agent’s model provider.

Change mode anytime:
  gbrain config set search.mode conservative|balanced|tokenmax

Database: /harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite
Verification record: /harness-state/gbrain-install-verification.json
